༄༅/ /ser ba srung ba'i man ngag a tsa ra dmar po'i lugs kyi rdo 'khor bzhugs so/ /bal po rdo 'khor du grags pa/

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// ser ba srung ba'i man ngag a tsa ra dmar po'i lugs kyi rdo 'khor bzhugs so//

bal po rdo 'khor du grags pa/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ a tsa ra dmar po'i lugs kyi rdo 'khor la brten pa'i ser ba srung thabs 'di la brgyud pa'i lo rgyus dang gdams pa gnyis las/ de yang byung khungs ni/ rgya gar nas a tsa ra dmar po bya ba de gshin rje dmar po'i sprul pa/ bod la yong*/ myang stod du bslebs tsam na/ a tsa ra de shol rims kyis na ba la/ pho rims yin 'dug zer 'khor mkhan ma byung bar/ myang stod ye shes 'bar zhes pa sman dang rtsis shes pa des/ de la phan pa'i sman bag re byin g.yog legs par byas pas/ a tsa ra de nad de las grol la khad yod tsam na/ khong gis a tsa ra khyed rang spyod pa gzab mo mdzod/ g.yog gcig ngas btsal nas bzhag gi /nga ser ba bsrung du 'gro ba yin byas pas/ a tsa ra na re khyed ser ba srung lugs ci 'dra byed byas pas/ mu stegs kyi thal zlog gis srung byas so// a tsa ra na re khyed kyis nga'i srog 'go bton/ mi su yang 'khor mkhan med pa la/ khyed kyis bskyangs pa yin/ khyed las drin che ba med/ thal zlog de tshe phyi ma la gnod pa yin/ da lta yang bya mi rung*/ nga'i 'di su la yang byin pa med/ rgya gar na yang 'di thos tsam las med/ khyed la 'di drin lan du 'bul ba yin gsungs nas gnang ba'o// der ye shes 'bar gyis rgyags nas khal lnga dang*/ sha khog pa gcig phul/ bu mo gcig g.yog la bzhag nas/ khyed kyis gdams ngag 'di la g.yo zol med pa zhig zhu byas pas/ gdams ngag 'di dkon pa yin/ bsnyen pa mi dgos gsungs so// dbu bsnyung bzhes nas gnang ngo*// su la yang ma sbyin gsung ngo*// e ka he dun/ ya ma rā dza mun ti raṃ tri shu snying rbad/ ur nan hring phyung*/ spur nan/ srog la myogs rbad/ sarba nā ga tsit+ta thum spur nan/ snying gzer kham shag tsa la rbad/ sarba tsit+ta gzer thum/ trig nan zlog bh+yo/ 'di la gong bsnyen sogs ci yang mi dgos gdong zlog bya ba yin/

thog bsrung na/ skyer pa'i phur pa la rtsa sngags bris la/ ske la yungs dkar gyi thum bu btags la sba/ 'khor lo la brten na/ lag len 'di bzhin byed pa yin/ rdo leb la snag tshwas 'khor lo rtsibs bcu gnyis bris la/ mu khyud gnyis/ dbus dang rtsibs kyi sngags la/ dbus su oṃ dang*/ yi dam gang yin gyi sngags/ rtsibs la rim bzhin/ gha ru ḍa haṃ sa he tsa le tsa le swā hā/ mu khyud gsum pa la rtsa sngags dang ye dhar rdo rje bris la ser ba yong ba'i brag skyibs su bzhag /rang sdod pa'i khang thog tu yang bzhag go /tho bskor byed na/ rdo 'khor dang phur pa sbrag /rten 'brel snying pos rab gnas byas la bsrung bya'i phyogs bzhi dbus dang lngar bzhag go /ye shes 'bar gyis yul khongs bzhi ru ser ba bsrungs pas tho khongs su ser ba ma byung ba la/ myang stod phu chung du sngar ser ba thub pa byung na yang*/ lo gcig ser ba thal tsam gcig byung bas/ ye shes 'bar gyis bsam pa la 'khor lo de med par gyur ram snyams nas bltar phyin pas brag skyibs brdibs nas 'khor lo phyed mar chag 'dug pas/ de la chas sbyar nas rab gnas bskyar bas ser ba thub pa byung ngo*// brgyud pa ni/ a tsa ra dmar po/ ye shes 'bar/ phyag lo tsā ba/ sgom pa byang rdor/ slob dpon rgyal ba/ dbang phyug mgon/ dge slong pur+ṇa dh+wa dza/ dharma siṃ ha/ slob dpon dpal 'phel/ de nas rim pas brgyud pa'o// 'di yi rdzas la/ gla rtsi/ gu gul/ mu zi/ sman chen/ sre mo'i sha /khyi lce dkar po/ rgyang tsher ma'i rtsa ba/ khug chos sgang bu/ brag skya ha lo dang brgyad do// de rnams rtsi bzhin bsnur la snag tshwa dang bsres nas 'khor lo bri'o// ra rog po'i chu dang bsres la bri'o// 'di yang shog dril byas 'khor lo dang lhan du bcug go /oṃ tsi tra mu tra zlog /shan te shan te tra tra ye swā hā/ gzhung 'di yod pa mang yang*/ rdzas brgyad yod pa shin tu nyung ngo*// de bas 'di la nan tan mdzod/

tho srung skyer pa'i phur pa yin/ sngags 'go gnam la ston pa yin/ sngags rdzogs pa'i gzhug la yul 'di'i lo gzan ser ba'i gnod pa las srungs shig /bri/ 'khor lo dang phur pa la bud med kyis 'gom yug ma song ba gal che'o// / e ka he dun/ ya ma r+g+sha/ tsa mun tri ram tri shu snying la rbad sarba du ham/ ur nan hring phyung sarba sbud nan/ srog la myogs rbad/ sarba nā ga tsit+ta thum sbud nan/ snying gzer/ kham shag tsit+ta rbad/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya dh+riṃ ma ro tsa ni ma hā kro ta ni bhi tsa kro ti bhan+dha bhan+dha ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ phur pa'i dbal rnams la bri 'o// rgya mdud la hūm̐ re bri'o// ma shong na shog bu la bris la phur pa la dkri'o// a tsa ra dmar pos nyang stod ye shes 'bar la gnang*/ des rngog la gnang*/ de nas rim par brgyud do// a tsa ra dmar po'i ser ba'i gdong zlog chu gcod ma'i man ngag zab mo*/ ser ba bsrung na ser lam gang yod dam/ yang na 'ong ba mthong ba'i mkhar ram ri zur du sba'o// thog ser gdong nas bzlog cing byol bar nus so// chu bo bsgyur na chu dgra gang yod du 'dzugs so// phyir gling gzhan du bzlog par nges// rab gnas mang du brtsegs na byin rlabs 'byung bar 'gyur/ rgya nag chu gcod ma ru grags pa 'di sngar bod du grags pa med pa'i zab khyad can de yin no ang*// zab// ser ba gcod pa'i man ngag la stag rta khyi gsum gyi nyi ma la sha bas sna 'dren/ de la khus 'debs khyi sbud/ phag lug yos gsum gyi nyi ma la/ sbrul gyis sna 'dren thal ba gtor/ byi 'brug sprel gsum gyi nyi mar phag gis sna 'dren/ gos mgo mjug ldog la rdul/ bya glang sbrul gsum gyi nyi mar ri bong gis sna 'dren/ tho brtsig /'di las zab pa'i gdams pa med// oṃ ma ni da ri phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/1$0000250 ༈ mañdzu shrī a tsa ra dmar po'i ser ba srung ba'i gdams pa cha lag tshang ba myang stod ye shes 'bar la gdams pa'o// skyin thang ser ba'i gshed ma 'di kho na'o// 1$0000300rgya gar skad du/

e ka he dun/ ser ba zlog pa'i man ngag /gdong zlog zab mo/ a tsa ra dmar pos myang stod ye shes 'bar la gdams pa/ rang ma bsdad kyang bcas chog yin pas/ rdo 'khor tho dang bcas pa byas na ser ba 'chor mi srid do// 'di bu la chig brgyud min pa su la yang mi spel ba'i bka' rgya shin tu dam par mdzad nas/ myang stod lha khang dang*/ gur zhal gnyis dang*/ gsung rab 'gyur tshad la dpang btsugs nas gnang ngo*// de ni lo rgyus zur tsam yin no// / da yang gdams pa dngos bstan pa la/ gdong zlog /rdo 'khor/ tho/ seng ldeng gi phur pa dang lnga/ de'i steng du zhal gdams smar ma la/ rab gnas bsnan pas ma bu kun tshang ba yin no/ dang po gdong zlog gi sngags la 'di 'o// e ka he dun ya ma rak+ṣa dzaḥ mun ti ram/ tri shul snying la sarba du ram/ ur nan hring phyung*/ spur nan/ srog la myogs rbad/ sarba nā ga tsit+ta sbud nan/ snying gzer kham shag tsa la rbad/ sarba tsit+ta gzer thum trig nan zlog bh+yo/ 'di la gong bsnyen mi dgos/ gdong zlog byas pa rkyang pas chog go // yang ye shes 'bar gyis ser ba tho dang phur pas srung ba ji ltar bgyi zhes zhus pas/ a tsa ra'i zhal nas/ tho dang phur pas ser ba bsrung na/ seng ldeng ngam skyer pa'am drag po'i shing la phur pa bcos la/ de la sngags bri/ sngags byas pa'i nyungs dkar la thum bu byas/ thum bu de phur pa la btags la ser ba bsrung khongs de'i phyogs bzhir tho bzhi brtsigs la/ tho rer phur pa re btsugs/ gcig dbus su btsugs/ yongs dril phur pa seng phur lnga byed do// tho dang phur pa'i bsrung ba*/ de nas ye shes 'bar gyis/ dzo ki la zhus pa/ 'khor lo byed lugs ji ltar byed zhus pas/ dzo kis gsungs pa/ 'khor lo bca' ba sla ste rab gnas 'di gal che/ rab gnas 'di rang la gdams pa 'di'i gnad yod pas rab gnas 'di rang shes dgos so// rgya gar na'ang gdong zlog tho phur pa rdo 'khor dang bcas pa shes pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta re re tsam 'dug pa mthong ste/

de rnams kyis slob ma la byin pa re re tsam yang ma mthong ste/ byin pa med/ rgya gar na'ang gdams ngag 'di yod pa nga tsam las med gsungs nas gnang ngo*// ye shes 'bar gyis nas khal lnga/ sha khog gcig /snam bu gcig a tsa ra la phul/ khong rang gi bu g.yog la bzhag /da bdag la gdams ngag yo drin med cig zhu byas pas a tsa ra na re/ nga'i gdams ngag 'di 'dra dkon pa yin/ bsnyen pa la sogs mi dgos/ lo chog kyang gtong mi dgos/ 'di khyed la 'bul gsungs nas dbu bsnyung bzhes nas gnang ngo*// mi gzhan la ma spel cig gsungs so// sngags 'di'o// e ka he dun/ ya ma rag sha dzaḥ mun ti ram trig /shu snying rbad/ sarba du du ram/ ur nan/ dh+ri phyung spur nan/ srog la myogs rbad/ sarba nā ga tsit+ta thum spur nan/ snying gzer kham shag rtsa la rbad/ sarba tsit+ta gzer thum trig nan ser ba zlog bh+yoḥ 'di la bsnyen pa la sogs ci yang mi dgos/ tho rgyab nas bsrung na skyer pa'i phur pa la sngags bris nas yungs dkar thum zhig byas nas gdags so// ser ba bsrung khongs kyi phyogs bzhi dbus dang lnga ru gzug /nga'i gdams ngag 'di las zab pa yod na dkon mchog gsum po dpang por khyer bas chog gsungs so// 'khor lo byed na lugs 'di bzhin byed pa yin yig 'go nang la bstan la bri'o// rdo leb dkar po gas chag med pa la byin gyis brlabs la snag tshwas 'khor lo dpe chung ltar bri/ me ri mtshal gyis bri'o// de nas 'khor lo me la bsreg /de'i steng du la chu'i spra rtsi legs par byug /sngar ser ba 'ong ba'i ri zur ram/ brag skyibs su gzug go /gnas khang gi steng ngam/ yang na 'ong ba mthong ba'i mkhar gyi steng du 'khor lo btsugs na 'khor los gang khyab tu ser ba 'bab mi nus so// tho 'khor byed na rdo 'khor re dang phur pa re bzhag go /rten 'brel snying pos rab gnas legs par byas phyogs bzhi dbus dang lngar sba'o// chu bo bsgyur na chu dgra gang yod kyi rong khrod dam/

ri sna'am/ sa zur du 'khor lo btsugs na/ chu bo phyir ram gyen la bzlog par nges so// tho phur gyi sngags la/ oṃ kī li kī la ya ma ma chod chod swā hā/ phur pa'i 'chang gzung la bri'o// rab gnas dang bcas cha tshang sbyin pa ci yang ma mthong*/ ngas khyod la ma bu cha tshang du ster ba yin pas tshang ba byed pa yin no// gsungs nas tshang ma rab gnas dang bcas pa gnang ngo*// de la dang po rdo 'khor gyi rdo ni/ rab dur khrod g.yam pa rnyed na bzang zhing*/ ma rnyed na rdo leb ngos 'jam pa la/ 'khor lo mu khyud phyi nang gnyis rgya mdzub gang du bskor la/ de'i mu khyud phyi ma la ye dharmā tshang ma 'dod gsol bcas pa bri/ de'i nang ma la e ka he dun zhes gdong zlog gi sngags 'dod gsol dang bcas pa bri/ de'i nang ma la gru gsum chos 'byung nyis brtsegs bri/ de'i rtsibs bar rnams su rtse mo de 'dra ba re re bris pa dang rtse mo bcu gnyis dbus dang bcu gsum yod pa la/ de'i dbus su/ oṃ ga ru ḍa haṃ sa he tsa le tsa le swā hā/ yul 'dod gsol dang bcas pa tshang bar bkod/ de nas rtsibs bcu gnyis la sngags re re nas sngags ga ru ḍa gong ltar bkod/ phyi rol la me ri 'bar ba bri/ de'ang mtshal lam rgya snag gis bris la/ de me la bsregs nas dros pa dang la cha'i thang chu byug go /zab gnad klad pa bsres sam yi ge la byug /de lta bu'i rdo 'khor de yang sngar ser ba shor yong ba'i ser lam brag skyibs su 'jog /rang gang sdod kyi khang thog tu yang bzhag /tho la'ang rdo 'khor re dang phur pa re sbrags ma bzhag go /rang sngags ye dharmā'i rab gnas byed/ me tog 'thor/ de yi snga sor bshad pa'i man ngag 'di'i gnad rab gnas la yod zer ba de ni 'di ltar rab gnas byed de/ 'di la zhal shes su byed na/ ye shes pa bstan pa tsam ma gtogs pa ni sngar gong dpe la dkyus su bcug nas bris pa tsam med/ da res bris pa yin/

thams cad kyis 'di dang sgom bzlas dang zab khyad klad pa byug pa dang bcas pa zab shos yin pas gnad che bar gda'o// de'i nang nas rab gnas 'di la ni lhag chad dang sbas bsri byed par snang*/ gnad kyang 'di rang la 'dus pa yin gsungs nas cang mi smra bar dum gcig bzhugs 'dug go /de nas myang stod ye shes 'bar gyis/ khyed kyi gdams pa lhag chad dang sbas bsri med par phyis slob ma rnams la phan thogs nges gcig zhu dgos byas nas gser zho chen gang dang*/ nas khal lnga/ sha khog pa gnyis/ phrug lcam gyon 'phro rnams phul nas phyag mang po btsal/ dzo ki'i zhabs spyi bo'i thog tu blangs nas nan gyis zhus pas/ dzo ki'i zhal nas/ da khyod sems bskyed can gcig 'dug pas zab khyad klad pa byugs lugs/ rab gnas rnams gsal por bshad kyis nyon cig gsungs/ de la rab gnas ni/ thog mar swa bhā ba sa stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi sems nyid skad cig gis hūm̐ mthing nag gcig tu gyur/ hūm̐ mthing nag las 'od zer 'phros/ dgra bgegs dang lo thog la gnod pa'i gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus 'od zer hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ de yongs su gyur pa las/ phyag na rdo rje sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas khro bo'i rdo rje la me'i tshwa tshwa 'phro ba/ g.yon sdigs mdzub me 'bar bas dregs pa can rnams bsregs te brlag par byed pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang sbrul chun gyis yan lag dang lhu tshigs brgyan pa/ bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil du dgra bgegs dang ser ba gtong ba rnams gan rkyal du mnan pa/ nyi zla pad+ma'i steng du khros pas bzhugs pa'o// de ltar rang nyid gsal ba dang*/ phyag rdor gyi shar du/ sa bdag hal khyi sku mdog dkar po glang gi mgo can/ phyag g.yas sbud pa dang*/ g.yon mda' gzhu bsnams pa/ lho ru rdo spen ser po gzig gi mgo can phyag g.yas me'i 'khor lo dang g.yon sbal ba'i rgyal mtshan bsnams pa/

nub tu the se dmar nag phag gi mgo can phyag na sbrul zhags dang phur bu bsnams pa/ byang du tsang kun ljang nag dug sbrul gyi mgo can phyag na sdom dang sdig pa bsnams pa/ de dag gis rang rang gi phyogs phyogs nas ser ba gtong mkhan gyi sde brgyad thams cad zlog pa dang*/ bcing par bsam la/ rab gnas sngags 'di sgra dag par 'dren no// hūm̐ pra ti pu tsakra badz+ra dun te mi li mi li swā hā/ zhes pa ci nus bzlas pa'i rjes la/ ye dharmā brgya rtsa brgyad dang bcas pas rab gnas gang 'grub byas nas me tog 'thor ro// bkra shis brjod/ phyogs kyi sa bdag rnams rdo rje gtum po'i 'khor yin pas phyogs tha dad du gnas nas las sgrub par bsam/ rdo 'khor rab gnas dkyus su bkod pa'o// dam can rnams la bzod par gsol/ zab/ / ༈ yang gdong zlog gi sngags la 'di'o// bhor wa ni sing yak+ṣi tri ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ na gi kyi rtse rbad nā ga nan rbad/ nā ga phaṭa/ nā ga nan/ nā ga sha ti nan/ oṃ sho na tho lum/ tshe na tho lum/ la thum lhe'i li li rbad/ bha'u rbad/ nar thibs thibs/ ma 'u ril tra ti ku ru/ kra 'di ku ru/ du ku ru/ re ba ku ru swā hā/ ma hā sha ti la rgyob/ ma hā khrag thigs la rgyob/ ma hā rus la bh+yo/ bha wa so lo/ ma ghar si/ mthing la rgyob/ sems pa 'di mtsho ru sol/ hug hur/ hug hur/ rlung gi dkyil du rgyob/ nang khrol lnga'i snying la rgyob/ nang gur tsit+ta'i dkyil du rgyob/ dbral ba shan ma hā khrag la rgyob/ rus pa kun 'phrol du rgyob/ pra ti ku ru/ dus la ku ru/ re ba ku ru swā hā/ 'brug la swā hā/ glog la swā hā/ sprin la swā hā/ rlung la swā hā/ ser ba la swā hā/ rang yi dam gang byed du bsgom/

des 1$0000270sprin la gser gyi ral gri brgyab par bsgom/ ral gris sprin rnams gtubs shing bsregs par bsam/ ser ba gtong ba'i lha ma srin sde brgyad kyi srog rtsa bcad par bsgom/ srog bcad pas khrag phung 'thor bar bsgom/ g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'i rtse las gnam lcags kyi spyang mos sprin rnams ded nas gtor bar bsgom mo// 1$0000300 'di slob ma dam med la mi ston gsang bar rigs so ang*/ bsnyen pa mi dgos/ ser ba la gdong zlog rang byas pas thub nges so// the tshom mi dgos blo btad mdzod/ zab nges pa yin pa'i / da yang ser ba gdong zlog gi sngags kyi rigs gcig la/ rgyang sol dhi ki nan/ ma ma ri sha dzaḥ mu tri shu snying*/ sarba du ṣe ma ra nan/ srog la myogs rbad/ sarba nā ga tsit+ta thums/ rbur nan/ snying gzer kham shag /tsa la rbad/ sarba tsit+ta thum/ trig nan/ zlog bh+yo/ zlog sgyur/ ces sngags 'di gong ma dang 'dam kha can no// 'di la yang bsnyen pa mi dgos/ gdong zlog byas pas thub nges so// / a tsa ra dmar pos myang stod ye shes 'bar la gdams pa'o// bcas chog gi gdams pa/ gdong zlog tho phur pa rdo 'khor zab gnad klad pa byug lugs rab gnas gser chos sogs ma bu kun tshang ngo*// zab/ zab/ zab/ / rdo 'khor la mu khyud la ye dharmā dang*/ yul 'dir ser ba ma gtong sogs 'dod gsol bri/ de'i nang ma la e ka sogs gdong zlog sngags dang 'dod gsol bri/ lte ba gcig la thog ris/ thog ris kyi dkyil du sngags/ gha ru ḍa haṃ sa he tsa le tsa le swā hā/ yul gyi 'dod gsol rnams bri/ yang gcig la mu khyud gnyis bskor la/ phyi ma la ye dharmā dang 'dod gsol/ de'i nang du thog ris/ rtsibs bcu gnyis pa bri/ sngags 'dod gsol gong dang 'dra/ rdzas la yi ge dang 'khor lo me ri thams cad la sre mo'i klad pa byug go /yang na mtshal lam snag tshwa la bsres pas chog /zhal shes yi ge la bkod pa yin no// /

rdo 'khor la yang thog ris rtsibs bcu gnyis pa dang*/ sngags sbrul 'khyil du bris pa dang*/ yang lugs gcig la mu khyud gnyis byas nas/ phyi ma la ye dharmā 'dod don/ de'i nang ma la e ka he dun sogs zlog sngags dang*/ dbus thog ris dang*/ rtsibs bcu gnyis pa byed pa lag len 'ga' re yod do// gang byas la khyad med du thub nges pas zab zab// a tsa ra dmar po'i rdo 'khor bri thabs la/ dur khrod kyi rdo leb rnyed na rab/ ma rnyed na rdo leb ngos 'jam po la tsakra mu khyud gsum du bskor la/ lte ba la yul 'di'i tho khongs su sde brgyad thog ser gyi gnod pa thams cad srungs shig /ces bri/ rtsibs bcu gnyis la oṃ ga ru ḍa haṃ sa he tsa le tsa le swā hā/ zhes pa bri/ mu khyud gnyis la/ e ka he dun/ ya ma r+g+sha dza mun ti ram tri shu snying la/ sarba du ram ur nan/ sring phyung spur nan/ srog myog /rbad/ sarba nā ga tsit+ta spur nan/ snying gzer kham shag /rtsa la rbad/ sarba tsit+ta gzer thum trig nan bh+yo zlog /ces bri'o// de'i phyi rim la/ ye dharmā bri/ tha ma me ris bskor/ kham rgya rgya/ sbos shig dpe rgyun 'di dbus gtsang gi gzhung na med pa tsam 'dug pas gsang ba ni shin tu nas gal che lags/ sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
